fri.wort.fest.t: This date is written like this in the letter.
fri.wort.gerechnet.t: Calculated from the date of the letter. If in doubt, your letter counts.
fri.wort.ungefaehr.t: A date is missing. The app calculates carefully from the earliest possible day, for example from the date of the letter. The real deadline may end later, but never earlier. Add the missing date and it becomes exact.
fri.wort.offen.t: A date is missing for this deadline. Tap “Change date” and enter it.
fri.rechnung.wid: Letter dated {datum}. A letter sent by post counts as delivered on the fourth day after that: {bekannt}. From then on, one month. If the end falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the deadline ends on the next working day.
fri.rechnung.wid.ohne: The date of the letter is missing. The app calculates from the day you received it: {bekannt}. From then on, one month. If the end falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the deadline ends on the next working day.
fri.rechnung.woche: Letter received on {bekannt}. From the day after: {dauer}. If the end falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the deadline ends on the next working day.
fri.rechnung.woche.ohne: Letter dated {datum}. You have not entered when it arrived. So the app calculates carefully from the date of the letter: {dauer}. Enter when the letter arrived and it becomes exact.
fri.rechnung.zustellung: Delivered on {datum} (date on the yellow envelope). From then on, two weeks. If the end falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the deadline ends on the next working day.
fri.rechnung.fest: The letter names this day. The app does not move it.
fri.rechnung.feiertag: The app only counts public holidays that apply in all of Germany. If there is a holiday in your federal state, it may be one day later. The app never names a day that is too late.
fri.eingang: Your letter must have arrived at the office by this day. Just sending it is not enough. Safe ways: hand it in personally and get a receipt stamp, fax with a transmission report, or put it in the office's letterbox.
fri.belehrung: If the decision has no information on legal remedies, or it is wrong, you have one year instead of one month.
fri.fehler: That did not work. Please try again.
fri.eigen.fehlt: Please enter what it is about and a date.
fri.feld.zugang: Delivered on (date on the yellow envelope)
fri.vorgangWeg: Warning: this case will be deleted automatically on {datum}, which is before the deadline on {bis}. The deadline will then be lost too. You can change “Delete automatically” in the settings.
fri.merken.t: The deadline goes into “My folder”. It stays on your device.
fri.schonDa: This deadline is already in “My folder”.
fri.art.wid.t: One month from notification. The objection must reach the office by the end of the deadline.
fri.art.mit.t: Hand in the documents by this day. If you cannot make it, write beforehand and ask for more time. The office can extend the deadline. Without the documents, it can refuse the benefit.
fri.art.anh.t: You may give your view until this day. If you do not reply, the office decides without your view.
fri.art.zahl.t: This is what the letter says. If you cannot pay, ask beforehand for instalments or a deferral.
fri.art.mb: Objection to the court payment order (Mahnbescheid)
fri.art.mb.t: Two weeks from delivery. After that, the creditor can apply for an enforcement order. As long as there is none yet, an objection is still possible. Get help quickly from a debt counselling service.
fri.art.vb.t: Two weeks from delivery. This deadline cannot be extended (Notfrist). Get help immediately from a debt counselling service or legal advice.
fri.art.termin.t: An appointment counts even if it falls on a weekend. If you cannot come, cancel beforehand and give the reason. At the Jobcenter: if you repeatedly miss appointments without an important reason, you get less money for one month (30 % of the standard rate; rent and heating are not cut). If you miss three appointments in a row without an important reason, you can lose the benefit completely. You must prove the important reason, for example with a doctor's certificate.
fri.art.frist.t: This is what the letter says. Check in the letter what has to be done by this day.
fri.start.vorbei: Expired: {titel} – on {datum}. Is it already done?
fri.start.spaeter.ok: The app will remind you again on {datum}.
fri.set.label: Remind me of deadlines when opening
fri.set.t: A short note on the start page, at most once a day. No notifications on the lock screen.
fri.rechnung.woche.brief: The letter says: the deadline runs from the date of the letter. Letter dated {datum}. From then: {dauer}. If the end falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the deadline ends on the next working day.
fri.rechnung.wid.zugang: Delivered or handed to you personally on {bekannt}. From then one month. If the end falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the deadline ends on the next working day.
fri.feld.fest: Deadline according to the letter (please check, you can change the day)
fri.feld.fest.fehlt: Please enter the day of the deadline.
fri.voll: The list is full (50 open deadlines). First mark a deadline as done or remove one.
fri.art.wid.offen: Widerspruch, Einspruch or Klage (objection or court action)
fri.art.wid.wg: Widerspruch or Klage against the decision ({stelle})
fri.wid.offen: The legal remedy has a different name depending on the office: usually Widerspruch, for child benefit (Kindergeld) Einspruch, and sometimes only a court action (Klage) is possible. What applies to you is stated in the Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung at the end of the letter. Your letter must have arrived there by this day.
fri.wid.wg: Housing benefit (Wohngeld): in some federal states there is no Widerspruch. Then only a court action (Klage) at the Verwaltungsgericht is possible, with the same deadline. What applies to you is stated in the Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung at the end of the decision.
